coordinates.semantic_generation_k: Authoritative SSOT generation. Increment only when an accepted child return or other governed event applies an authoritative delta to the governed SSOT.
coordinates.event_sequence_e: Ordered Golden Thread event count at the checkpoint boundary. Any accepted/rejected/deferred/control/history event may advance e without advancing k.

dual_identity.ssot_digest: Digest of accepted authoritative SSOT payload. May remain unchanged while thread/projection history advances. Control-only checkpoints may use null when engineering_ssot_changed=false.
dual_identity.thread_digest: Exact Golden Thread head_event_digest at the checkpoint boundary.
dual_identity.projection_digest: Deterministic materialized-view digest from golden_thread.py rebuild.
dual_identity.checkpoint_digest: sha256 canonical JSON digest of the temporal checkpoint excluding checkpoint_digest itself.
dual_identity.git_anchor: Exact repository + commit SHA for the control-plane state that generated the checkpoint.

injection.rule: Each injection_key and idempotency_key shall be unique within a ledger projection; identical input shall not create a second child obligation.

disposition.rule: A child disposition changes the Golden Thread. Only ACCEPT with authoritative_delta_applied=true may advance semantic_generation_k.

transition_rules: REJECT advances event_sequence_e but shall not advance semantic_generation_k.
DEFER advances event_sequence_e but shall not advance semantic_generation_k.
ACCEPT without authoritative_delta_applied advances event_sequence_e but shall not advance semantic_generation_k.
ACCEPT with authoritative_delta_applied=true advances semantic_generation_k by one per distinct accepted authoritative delta.
An authoritative delta requires an accepted_authoritative_delta_digest and a non-null resulting ssot_digest.
Parent orchestration PASS shall not compensate child authority or a non-compensating child gate.
Negative/rejected evidence and deferred re-entry contracts remain in the immutable thread after later acceptance or supersession.
Historic checkpoints are immutable projections; later development creates successor checkpoints rather than editing prior milestone identity.

progressive_idempotency.I0_input: same idempotency_key => no duplicate child obligation
progressive_idempotency.I1_replay: same sealed ledger => same thread_digest and projection_digest
progressive_idempotency.I2_transition: same base k + same ordered accepted authoritative delta set + same resulting SSOT => same successor k and ssot_digest
progressive_idempotency.I3_recursive: same ledger boundary => same expand-root/trace subtree and checkpoint digest
progressive_idempotency.I4_temporal: same sealed historic ledger boundary + same control schema => same milestone checkpoint

dov: base Golden Thread ledger verifies before checkpoint generation
checkpoint projection_digest equals deterministic rebuild digest
duplicate child injection keys and duplicate idempotency keys fail closed
authoritative ACCEPT without accepted delta digest or result SSOT digest fails closed
rebuilding the same checkpoint twice yields the same checkpoint_digest
